text:
sqlpipe is a command-line tool that moves data out of Postgres and into S3 without the glue code. Point it at a table, give it a bucket, and it streams rows straight to columnar Parquet files—handling type mapping, compression, and partitioning along the way. Whether you're feeding a data lake, archiving cold tables, or building an analytics layer on Athena, Trino, or Spark, sqlpipe keeps your object storage in step with your database.

Built for repeatable pipelines, sqlpipe supports both full-table snapshots and incremental syncs driven by a watermark column, so only new or changed rows are written on each run. It's a single static binary with no runtime dependencies, making it easy to drop into a cron job, container, or CI workflow.
